description.zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
description.en: The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English.

description.zh:
Web fallback行为类型。

0：返回指定内容。

1：跳转到指定页面。
description.en:
The type of the web fallback behavior.

0: The specified content is returned.

1: Redirect to the specified page.

The encoding type.

0: plain text

1: JSON text

Specifies whether to enable the rule.

0: disable

1: enable
The unique ID of the gateway.
The ID of the concurrency rule.
The maximum number of concurrent requests.
The HTTP text to be returned.
The URL to be redirected to.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse update-gateway-isolation-rule --id 358 --gateway-id 14407 --gateway-unique-id gw-e2d226bba4b2445c9e29fa7f82160000 --route-id 52853 --route-name routeName --max-concurrency 100 --behavior-type 0 --body-encoding 0 --response-status-code 429 --response-content-body text --response-redirect-url www.000000.com --enable 0 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
